method_card.objective: Find indexed publications with an investigator-selected query and identify open full-text candidates.
method_card.mechanism: Supply one input request {"schema":"gx.scholarly-request/1"} and parameter query (a free-text string); use the same request with a new query to refine a search. Europe PMC and Crossref each return a ranked page of up to 12 results. A previous search-snapshot.json and its identical query replays saved source responses offline.
method_card.estimator: candidates.json lists title, bibliographic identifiers, source ranks, type and fetchable_pmcids for each deduplicated publication. search-snapshot.json retains the provider response bytes, query, observation times, statuses and digests.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Public catalogue and original-source records; no trained model.

manifest.licence: GX release source. Original materials retain their respective licences.
manifest.licence_basis: Europe PMC and Crossref public metadata and Open Access JATS terms; intake records retain original source rights.
manifest.limitations: Covers one ranked page per provider. Empty and unavailable sources have different statuses. Bibliographic matches are leads, not experimental observations. The catalogues can index the same publication.
